title: Glob: AbortSignal cancellation bypass allows post-timeout filesystem traversal
reason: Inside the npm tree that @semantic-release/npm bundles at glob 13.0.6 (fixed in 14.0.2). `overrides` cannot reach a bundled dependency, so it cannot be cleared from this package. Issue #8 carries the evidence; remove this entry when the release toolchain ships a fixed bundled version.

title: minimatch has potential denial of service via globparts amplification
reason: The same bundled npm tree, at minimatch 10.2.5 (fixed in 11.0.1). A denial of service reachable only from the release toolchain's own glob patterns on files we control, not from anything this package runs. Issue #8 carries the evidence.
